label: VEGFA+
resolved_names: tonsil epithelial cell (surface / reticulated crypt epithelium)
tissue_context: palatine tonsil epithelium (surface stratified squamous / reticulated crypt epithelium)
evidence: Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 fine annotation 'VEGFA+' (cl_map_order 231), derived from King HW et al. 2021 Sci Immunol (DOI 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768, PMID 34623901). The label names VEGFA (vascular endothelial growth factor A) as the discriminating transcript for an epithelial-cell subset of the tonsil. The tonsil epithelium comprises two compartments: a lining surface stratified squamous epithelium and specialised reticulated crypt (lymphoepithelium / follicle-associated) epithelium overlying the lymphoid tissue. ASTA indexes only the atlas ABSTRACT (CorpusId 238530091), which does not describe this epithelial subset; the resolved name and biological placement (VEGFA as a hypoxia-responsive angiogenic secreted factor produced by epithelial cells) are supported from the broader tonsil-epithelial and VEGFA literature rather than the atlas full text.
